meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Lending rates by occupation of the borrower and the weighted average deposit rate, for every bank group, as on 31 March 2005 to 2014 (discontinued)
meta.note: RBI, Bank Group-wise and Occupation-wise Weighted Average Lending Rate and Deposit Rate (Discontinued) (DBIE report 1205; also 735), from the BSR returns; as on 31 March. A separate ruler from the monthly WALR and WADTDR series.
